tools.description:
Editor utilities — project info, console logs, preferences, build, preview, run/stop/refresh, reload.
Groups: project_*, console_*, log_*, pref_*, build*, server_*, run, stop, refresh_preview, reload.
"run" launches preview; with no platform it follows the preview dropdown in the editor (browser/simulator/editor), pass platform only to override. "stop" stops editor preview. "refresh_preview" reloads the ALREADY RUNNING preview in place — use it after editing scenes or scripts instead of stop+run. "reload" reloads the editor window itself (Developer → 重新加载).
Example: {action:"run", platform:"editor"} → edit something → {action:"refresh_preview"} → {action:"stop"}

tools.description:
Capture — scene layout JSON + real screenshot.
Actions: scene_snapshot (full scene JSON), node_snapshot (focused subtree JSON), screenshot (PNG).
screenshot has TWO modes:
  • mode:"content" (RECOMMENDED for pixel diffs) — returns a REAL engine render of ONLY the Canvas content at design resolution with a transparent (or chosen) background: NO editor panels/grid/gizmos/FPS overlay. Runs the built web runtime headlessly internally (one MCP call → content PNG). Requires scenePath. Renders the LAST BUILT (saved) scene; reuses build/web-mobile (auto-builds if missing; rebuild:true forces a fresh build, ~60s). Deterministic. Returns pngBase64.
  • mode:"window" (default, legacy) — PNG of the Creator editor window via OS capture; includes panels/grid. Returns contentRect (the scene-viewport box, when detectable) so you can crop.
Use scene/node_snapshot for position/size/component data; use screenshot for a real visual.
Examples: {action:"screenshot", mode:"content", scenePath:"db://assets/scenes/Main.scene"} or {action:"screenshot", mode:"content", scenePath:"Sprite", width:1280, height:720, background:{r:0,g:0,b:0,a:0}, rebuild:true} or legacy {action:"screenshot"}

action.description: Capture action: scene_snapshot, node_snapshot or screenshot

background.description: screenshot(content): clear color {r,g,b,a} channels 0-255. Default transparent {0,0,0,0}.

chrome.description: screenshot(content): path to a Chrome/Chromium binary (default: system Google Chrome).

delay.description: screenshot(window): ms to wait before capturing so the scene finishes rendering, default 400.

height.description: screenshot(content): output pixel height. Default = project design resolution height.

inlineImage.description: screenshot: also return the PNG inline as an image block (default true).

maxWidth.description: screenshot(window): downscale to this width to limit size, default 1600. Set 0 to keep native resolution.

mode.description: screenshot: "content" = REAL Canvas-only content render at design resolution via internal headless runtime (transparent bg, no editor chrome/overlay; returns pngBase64). "window" = whole editor window (default, legacy; returns contentRect).

readyFrames.description: screenshot(content): how many frames to render before reading pixels (default 2) so async assets/layout settle.

rebuild.description: screenshot(content): force a fresh web build before capturing (default false — reuses build/web-mobile, building once if missing). Set true after editing/saving scenes so the capture reflects changes.

rect.description: screenshot(window): explicit crop rectangle in CSS pixels {x,y,width,height} relative to the window. Overrides region.

region.description: screenshot(window): "scene" auto-crops to the scene-editor viewport panel; "full" = whole window (default).

savePath.description: screenshot: output path (db:// or absolute fs path). Defaults to <project>/temp/mcp-screenshots/.

scenePath.description: screenshot(content): REQUIRED. Scene to render (db://assets/.../X.scene or a bare scene name). The built runtime loads this scene by name.

timeout.description: screenshot(content): headless run timeout ms (default 45000; build, when needed, is given ≥90000).

width.description: screenshot(content): output pixel width. Default = project design resolution width.

window.description: screenshot(window): which editor window to capture (default main = largest visible window).
